reflection.hindsight: The attempt failed at the time limit. Short base advances brought the estimated target within reach, and the final downward move reached within 7 mm of the requested grasp pose. However, navigation consumed much of the budget, and the arm approach used 60 steps rather than the 22-step minimum reported by the path check. Only eight steps remained when I commanded gripper closure. No closure result or secure hold was observed, and no return was attempted. The visible can and accurate TCP pose did not establish successful finger alignment. I should have budgeted for actual arm execution time and preserved a firm reserve for grasp verification and return.
